title: Temenus
summary: Raleigh names Temenus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Temenus, of whose family the Kings of Macedon were, of the race of Hercules, and by nation Argiues. Hercules was not attached. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter I, §. I, sig. 460a
